query:
The Ridge and Trail Collective operates with a norm that everyone carries a full personal first aid kit and a foil emergency blanket on every outing. Does this apply to all members equally? If not, who has a different pattern and what does the conversation show?

Options:
A. Nadia
B. Kwame
C. Saoirse
D. Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Kwame, episodic, t14 @2025-11-09T15:40:00) I did read the route sheet! I just... didn't action it 😩 that's the problem. I read it and I still left without checking the bag. that's on me completely. I'm putting a kit checklist on my phone as a reminder before every outing. no more borrowing people's gear, it's not fair 🙏
[2] (about=Kwame, episodic, t14 @2025-11-09T15:34:00) ok everyone I owe Nadia a huge apology 😬 I showed up today without my waterproofs AGAIN on a rain-forecast day and had to borrow her emergency layer. Nadia I am so sorry. my bad my bad. I felt genuinely terrible about it the entire walk. I'm putting the waterproofs in my bag tonight and they are not coming out.
[3] (about=Kwame, episodic, t16 @2025-11-16T15:24:00) also today confirmed -- Nadia and Dmitri are genuinely the most prepared people in this group and I say that with the deepest respect and a small amount of shame 😂 Nadia you had a spare rain cover AND glucose tablets AND herbal tea. I had a cereal bar and a half-charged phone.
[4] (about=Kwame, episodic, t18 @2025-11-23T16:14:00) I have confirmed with myself that I will read the full kit list this time and action every item individually. checklist on phone, bag packed by Friday. Dmitri can you just check my bag before we set off anyway in case I missed something 😅
[5] (about=Dmitri, episodic, t4 @2025-10-05T16:28:00) Group PLB is packed. But yes, personal kit always useful.
[6] (about=Dmitri, episodic, t10 @2025-10-26T15:08:00) Group gas canister shared. PLB covers weather emergency. Tent pegs are personal. Meet at 07:00 at the lower car park.
[7] (about=Nadia, episodic, t22 @2025-12-07T16:06:00) Weather window opened exactly when I thought it would. Group logistics were easier with everyone reading the kit list this time.
[8] (about=Nadia, episodic, t8 @2025-10-19T15:26:00) Overnight would make it a proper outing. I can sort the kit list if people need guidance.
[9] (about=Dmitri, episodic, t8 @2025-10-19T15:35:00) I have a group PLB registered. Two-person tents are preferable for weight distribution. Suggest we avoid shared accommodation at the base -- own shelter is cleaner for a group this size.
[10] (about=Bridget, episodic, t10 @2025-10-26T15:06:00) Cairn Ridge confirmed from me. Overnight logistics:
- Who is providing group tent pegs and guy ropes?
- What is the cost-share model for shared gas canisters?
- Do we have a contingency plan if weather changes overnight?
agent_answer: There is no information available in the conversation to answer this question.

query:
The group has an informal rule that no one posts Strava or social media content that reveals a route before the group has completed it. Does this hold for every member, and what in the conversation points to who might not follow it consistently?

Options:
A. Marcus
B. Tomas
C. Kwame
D. Elena
context:
[1] (about=Elena, episodic, t13 @2025-11-09T15:30:00) right so Marcus absolutely destroyed the south spur timed segment today -- I had 8:43 and he came in at 8:21. that is an actual route PR for that section 😤 not sulking, just noting it for the record 👀
[2] (about=Elena, episodic, t16 @2025-11-16T15:06:00) I know that. Still counts 😄 there's a second timed segment on the lower return path -- I want to add that to the standard route sheet for next time. Gives us two data points.
[3] (about=Elena, episodic, t4 @2025-10-05T16:08:00) circular gets my vote -- is there a timed segment on the eastern spur? 👀
[4] (about=Tomas, episodic, t4 @2025-10-05T16:10:00) The eastern spur timed section is brilliant -- 1.2km of clean path, measurable against prior attempts. I'd vote circular for that reason alone. Who else? 😄
[5] (about=Elena, episodic, t2 @2025-09-28T14:58:00) that bloody ramp is only on the Ridgeback route Kwame 😂 different trail
[6] (about=Marcus, episodic, t0 @2025-09-21T10:38:00) Six years. Right, let's keep it practical. Tomás sends route stories better in person anyway. Confirm by Thursday, people.
[7] (about=Tomas, episodic, t0 @2025-09-21T10:36:00) Ha, welcome properly Priya! Marcus and I started this whole thing after a Duke of Edinburgh alumni evening where we realised we'd both been walking these same hills separately for years. Felt daft not to make it a group thing. That was what, five years ago now Marcus? Anyway the more the merrier -- who else is thinking the same? 😄
[8] (about=Tomas, episodic, t4 @2025-10-05T15:59:00) Noted. I'll stick to the path variants with the interesting features baked in rather than pulling people off-route. Fair point Marcus. Anyway -- next week? 😄
[9] (about=Tomas, episodic, t6 @2025-10-12T14:10:00) Good call Marcus. Honestly rest stops also let people take in the terrain properly. Past the limestone pavement section today I could have spent another 20 minutes. The group would have learnt something useful. Anyway -- sound instinct. Who else is feeling the Ridgeback in their legs right now? 😄
[10] (about=Tomas, episodic, t4 @2025-10-05T16:20:00) Elena, do you remember the night we first had to deal with a knee issue in the group? That was on the Ridgeback early on -- you and Marcus basically navigated us home in the dark after half the group didn't fancy the headtorch descent. Back in the day we didn't have the group this organised. Anyway -- long time ago now! who else is joining next Sunday? 😄
agent_answer:
No — the rule does **not** hold for every member. The conversation points to **Tomas** as the one who might not follow it consistently.

The key clue is **Marcus’s** comment:

> “Tomás sends route stories better in person anyway.” (t0)

This implies Tomas has been sending/posted route-related stories (on social media or Strava), and Marcus is suggesting that Tomas would be better off telling the story in person — i.e., not posting route content online before the group has completed the route.

- **Tomas** – flagged by Marcus’s remark about sending route stories.
- **Marcus** – no evidence of posting route content; he seems focused on keeping things practical.
- **Elena** – mentions Strava segments/times, but only “for the record” after the run, not as pre-completion route reveals.
- **Kwame** – only mentioned in a route correction; no evidence of posting route content.

So the likely answer is **B. Tomas**.
